title: Check if Number is a Sum of Powers of Three
summary: Determine if a given integer can be expressed as the sum of distinct powers of three.
statement: Determine if a given integer can be expressed as the sum of distinct powers of three. Return true if possible, otherwise return false. An integer is a power of three if it equals 3 raised to some integer exponent.
constraints: Use each nonnegative power of three at most once.
Return whether their sum can equal n.
hints: A sum of distinct powers of three has a base-three representation containing only digits zero and one.
Repeatedly inspect n modulo three and divide by three.
Return false on remainder two; otherwise continue until n is zero.
Base representation is unique, so digit two is exactly the need to reuse a power and digits zero/one construct the desired sum.
editorial: Base representation is unique, so digit two is exactly the need to reuse a power and digits zero/one construct the desired sum.
